items.title: Miden Opens Its Invite-Only Partner Mainnet, Privacy Guardrails Included
items.summary: Invited users can now move real funds on the Polygon spin-off's privacy chain, though validators can still see private inputs for now.

items.title: Hyperliquid Formally Backs Kraken Parent's Push for US-Regulated Perps
items.summary: Hyperliquid named Payward its intended first CFTC-regulated HIP-3* deployer, though approval, a launch date, and HIP-3* mainnet are still pending.

items.title: Keystone Breach Widens as Attacker Grabs Its Device Authentication Key
items.summary: The hardware wallet maker will destroy 18,835 old devices and says it can't fully rule out fakes among units received after Oct. 20th.

items.title: Crypto's Two Answers to AI Bug Hunters
items.summary: As AI makes bugs cheap to find, crypto is splitting between agility and minimalism.

items.title: Uniswap v4 Is Now an Aggregator
items.summary: Uniswap's new Aggregator Hooks plug seven outside liquidity sources, covering more than 90% of DEX activity on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain, into v4.

items.title: CME-Backed Group Pushes Back on Kalshi as Phantom Rolls Out Prediction Markets
items.summary: The Commodity Markets Council wants the CFTC to block Kalshi's first oil perp, as Kalshi's October volume hits $55.33B and Phantom brings its markets to US users.
